summary: Compose high-precision coefficients, historical diagnostic coordinates and rational evaluation.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: Coefficient construction precedes ndgrid evaluation; approximation applicability is separate from construction and plotting.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: J
inputs.description: Number of simple rational poles in the constructed Padé approximation.
inputs.constraints: IntegerJ>=1; approximation domain separately checked. No fixed-table family restriction applies to coefficient construction.

inputs.name: I
inputs.description: Number of Taylor matching equations; K=2J-I inverse-power equations.
inputs.constraints: Integer0<=I<=2J. Meaningful accuracy must be independently checked for selected J/I and z domain.

inputs.name: precision
inputs.description: Decimal coefficient/root construction precision; numeric result ports remain complex128.
inputs.constraints: Integer>=32; repeated/unresolved roots fail explicitly. Higher precision alone does not certify finite-J approximation accuracy.

outputs.name: J
outputs.description: Number of simple poles.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: I
outputs.description: Taylor matching equation count.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: K
outputs.description: Inverse-power matching equation count, 2*J-I.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: precision_digits
outputs.description: Decimal precision used for coefficient and root construction.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: bzj
outputs.description: Simple-pole residues in the refined pole order.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: czj
outputs.description: Refined simple poles, binary64 view.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: p
outputs.description: Numerator coefficients in descending polynomial order.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: q
outputs.description: Denominator coefficients in descending polynomial order.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: pq
outputs.description: Solved two-sided coefficient vector before descending-order rearrangement.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: Mpq
outputs.description: Two-sided matching linear system matrix.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: Matching system right-hand side.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: moments
outputs.description: Binary64 sums sum(b), sum(b*c), sum(b*c*c).
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: high_precision_linear_residual
outputs.description: The normalized matching-system residual, returned as a decimal string.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: high_precision_root_residual
outputs.description: Normalized polynomial residual for each refined pole. Strings retain construction precision independently of binary64 numeric ports.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: high_precision_poles
outputs.description: Complex refined poles at declared decimal precision. Strings retain construction precision independently of binary64 numeric ports.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: high_precision_residues
outputs.description: Complex simple-pole residues at declared decimal precision. Strings retain construction precision independently of binary64 numeric ports.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: precision_claim
outputs.description: Construction precision and separate approximation-applicability limit.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: x
outputs.description: Real coordinate varying along the first ndgrid axis.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: y
outputs.description: Imaginary coordinate varying along the second ndgrid axis.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: z
outputs.description: Complex diagnostic coordinate x+1i*y.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

outputs.name: ZJ
outputs.description: sum_j bzj[j]/(z-czj[j]) evaluated on the historical diagnostic grid.
outputs.constraints: Returned on successful completion; this diagnostic does not independently certify physical applicability.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
supported: Constituent generator domains and resolved simple poles.
excluded: A colored diagnostic grid is not an independent Z accuracy test.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError unless integer J>=1, integer 0<=I<=2J and integer precision>=32; no fixed-table family restriction. Rational evaluation at an exact grid pole raises ZeroDivisionError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError retains its NativeReceipt for unavailable, failed or timed-out owned-scratch execution; no checkout/network fallback. Coefficient construction and evaluation are Python-only.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Linear-solve errors propagate. ArithmeticError for unresolved/repeated/collapsed roots, failed polynomial/linear residual or the bounded 100-step Newton refinement; FloatingPointError for unrepresentable binary64 poles/residues. Nonfinite evaluated ZJ raises FloatingPointError.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

example.description: A bounded J4/I4 construction and its diagnostic grid.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.workflows import regenerate_jpole
r = regenerate_jpole({'J': 4, 'I': 4, 'precision': 80})
assert r['ZJ'].shape == (101, 101)

nodes.description: Construct complete two-sided Padé coefficients, refined poles/residues and diagnostics.
Obtain the fixed historical diagnostic ndgrid.
Extract actual grid.state x,y,z; preserve row/column orientation.
Evaluate the constructed poles on the actual grid.
Merge all seventeen construction fields with x,y,z and evaluated ZJ; grid receipt is not returned by this graph.

edges.description: Project the returned diagnostic grid state.
Supply actual constructed bzj to rational evaluation.
Supply actual constructed czj to rational evaluation.
Supply actual complex ndgrid to rational evaluation.

execution.mode: Explicit Python scientific composition; ordinary data edges form a DAG and any iteration is separately bounded.
execution.ordering: Construct coefficients, obtain grid, evaluate with actual bzj/czj and grid.z, then merge the complete returned fields.
branches: No feedback; fixed diagnostic grid is not an approximation-validity domain.
execution.state_ownership: Invocation owns scratch, point index, carried guess and completed results; caller mappings are not mutated.
execution.failure_propagation: First constituent failure propagates without a successful graph result.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
